name: Dubai
about: Nov–Mar is warm and pleasant, summer (Jun–Aug) is extremely hot and humid — best avoided for outdoor time.
overview: A hyper-modern desert metropolis of record-breaking towers and five-star excess, with the old souks, dunes, and creek still a short drive from the skyscrapers.
costOverview: Cheap eats exist here, but the marquee sights don't — a Burj Khalifa ticket alone costs more than a full day of food.
